_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a registered small cardamom grower eligible under the scheme guidelines of the Spices Board. 1. The rain water harvesting structure should not block the natural flow of water, streams, or drainage channels, and should not create objections from the local community or concerned authorities. 1. The constructed structure must be inspected by the designated officials, and assistance will be recommended only for eligible cases as per the approved delegation. 1. The Inspecting Officer must ensure that all scheme conditions are complied with before recommending the case for sanction. 1. Random checking of the approved structures may be conducted by the respective controlling officers.
